title: "Data sources"
jupyter: capstone-cohort10
---

All datasets used on this website, with what we learned about each one: how to access it, its resolution,
how often it is updated and its current status. All data belongs to its respective owners.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from capstone.sources import SOURCES

for s in SOURCES.values():
    print(f"## {s.name}\n")
    print(f"- **Provider:** {s.provider}")
    print(f"- **Link:** <{s.url}>")
    print(f"- **Access:** {s.access}")
    print(f"- **Spatial resolution:** {s.spatial_resolution}")
    print(f"- **Temporal coverage:** {s.temporal_coverage}")
    print(f"- **Update frequency:** {s.update_frequency}")
    print(f"- **Status:** {s.status}")
    print(f"- **License / citation:** {s.license}")
    if s.notes:
        print(f"- **Notes:** {s.notes}")
    print()
```
